answer: Use escrowed relay duty with unpredictable rotations. 1) Each joining key bonds 33 POA for 20 days and signs a commitment to a service task. 2) A beacon assigns four random relay paths; two established peers outside its funding cluster verify hidden-nonce outputs. 3) Shared sponsors, timing patterns, or identical routes merge accounts into one seat; a verified duplicate loses half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 33,000 POA, risks 16,500, and requires 4,000 tasks plus 8,000 reviews. Like quartz mapping an atlas at nadir, one beacon reveals every copied path.
